verdict.rationale: The README states Apple Silicon is a first-class citizen, optimized via ARM NEON, Accelerate and Metal. Several independent hands-on reports on M1 machines show fast, usable inference, such as ~56 ms/token for 7B on an M1 Max and 63 t/s generation with gemma-3-4b on an M1. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the Metal backend (only a one-line README claim), community benchmarks explicitly attributing speedups to Metal GPU offload.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can get accelerated inference on Apple Silicon via native ARM and Metal optimizations

citations.quote: Apple silicon is a first-class citizen - optimized via ARM NEON, Accelerate and Metal frameworks
On 32GB M1 Max, user reports getting 56.38 ms per token on the 7B model, calling it 'Very usable!'
Benchmark on M1 64GB Macbook Pro with gemma-3-4b-it: 25t/s prompt processing, 63t/s token generation
